messages:
Olga: Quick alert from today's onboarding smoke tests: sampleapp produced inconsistent embedding envelopes + a retry/idempotency leak when hitting the rerank path. Minimal repro below.
Olga: Using model string `redwood-embed-1024` from onboard script. Python client returns flat `embeddings: [[...1024],[...1024]]` but Node returns `result.data[*].vector` and in some shards the vectors are length 1280.
Ben: oof. can you paste the trimmed request/response shapes?
Olga: sure:
```
Request: POST /v1/embeddings { model: "redwood-embed-1024", inputs: ["q1","q2"] }
Node SDK resp: { data: [ { id: "0", vector: [..1280..] }, { id: "1", vector: [..1280..] } ] }
Python resp: { embeddings: [ [..1024..], [..1024..] ] }
```
Olga: Also seeing duplicate ingestion in retriever: server logs show original request then an auth-refresh replay which lost `x-idempotency-key` and `x-batch-signature` headers.
Theo: looks like two distinct but interacting bugs: 1) mixed routing -> variant returned different dim, 2) SDK retry path not preserving custom headers so server processed the replay as a fresh batch.
Olga: exact auth trace: `access_token expired -> sdk fetches refresh token -> sdk resends pending request` but the internal resend uses a fresh headers map and drops our helper-set headers.
Ben: impact: duplicate vectors in index + unstable ordering because Node's envelope uses `data[]` with ids; rerank helper expects stable array indexing. Some customers noticed score spikes in early onboarding runs.
Theo: temporary mitigations: sampleapp will normalize any of these shapes to canonical `embeddings[]` and validate vector length before sending to rerank. If header checksum missing on retry, fail loudly with clear guidance.
Olga: opened sampleapp PR to add normalization + soft-fail on missing signature: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/678
Ben: filed SDK issue to ensure retry copies all outbound headers and custom metadata: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1678 (assigning to node-sdk).
eng-runtime-bot: Created incident INC-2024-1902 (owner: eng-runtime, priority: P3).
Theo: infra follow-up: audit model alias map for `redwood-embed-1024` to ensure it doesn't route to multiple-dim variants. Add server-side log field `batch_signature` to help dedupe when header absent.
Olga: adding a cross-language parity test to CI that verifies both envelope shape and vector dimension for a handful of canonical prompts.
Ben: good. also add a small network-fault test: expire token mid-batch and assert idempotency header preserved on retry.
Theo: note for docs: add a short DX warning for onboarding integrators about envelope shape differences and recommend using SDK response-normalizer (coming).
ci-bot: CI run for samples on PR#678 queued.
Olga: will monitor INC-2024-1902 and post updates here. if you spot odd rerank delta reports from customers, paste them in this thread.
